newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank injects 10 bln baht into system.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank injects 10 bln baht into system.

text.p: Bank of Thailand governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Wednesday the central bank injected a total of 10.0 billion into the system in the morning.
"The market liquidity improved today as the overnight interbank rate eased," Rerngchai told reporters.

Dealers said the interbank rate was quoted at around 12.0 percent now compared with 12.0-12.50 percent late on Tuesday. They expected the rate to ease further later on Wednesday on higher liquidity in the market.
The BOT did not sell or buy U.S. dollars in deals with commercial banks, he added.
Dealers said this was a sign that the baht trading had normalised after being affected for several days by the hangover from offshore baht devaluation rumours.
